item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Validation and unit conversion for batches of rows.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nimport math\\n\\n\\ndef _valid_amount(value):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return whether value is a finite, nonnegative int or float.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    if isinstance(value, bool) or not isinstance(value, (int, float)):\\n        return False\\n    if value < 0:\\n        return False\\n    # Every Python int is finite. Calling math.isfinite on an extremely large\\n    # int attempts a float conversion and can raise OverflowError.\\n    return isinstance(value, int) or math.isfinite(value)\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request, policy):\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Validate rows and convert accepted amounts to the base unit.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    errors = []\\n    records = []\\n    seen_ids = set()\\n    unique = policy.get(\\\"unique\\\", False)\\n    units = policy[\\\"units\\\"]\\n    base_unit = policy[\\\"base_unit\\\"]\\n\\n    for index, row in enumerate(request[\\\"rows\\\"]):\\n        row_id = row.get(\\\"id\\\")\\n        if not isinstance(row_id, str) or not row_id:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"id\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        duplicate = unique and row_id in seen_ids\\n        if unique:\\n            seen_ids.add(row_id)\\n\\n        amount = row.get(\\\"amount\\\")\\n        if not _valid_amount(amount):\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"amount\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        unit = row.get(\\\"unit\\\", base_unit)\\n        try:\\n            known_unit = unit in units\\n        except TypeError:\\n            known_unit = False\\n        if not known_unit:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"unit\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        if duplicate:\\n            errors.append({\\\"row\\\": index, \\\"cause\\\": \\\"duplicate\\\"})\\n            continue\\n\\n        records.append({\\n            \\\"id\\\": row_id,\\n            \\\"amount\\\": amount * units[unit],\\n            \\\"unit\\\": base_unit,\\n        })\\n\\n    if errors:\\n        records = []\\n    return {\\\"ok\\\": not errors, \\\"records\\\": records, \\\"errors\\\": errors}\\n\"}"}
